_note: photo_roots is searched recursively at any depth, so a single top-level library folder full of camera/trip subfolders works fine as one entry -- no need to list every subfolder. You can also list multiple separate roots if your photos live in more than one place. Only .jpg/.jpeg images are picked up (any case). Optional cropping plugins can be enabled under 'plugins' -- see plugins.py for what each one needs installed.
